How to use

The JSON Formatter helps you clean up unreadable payloads, validate syntax before API calls, and inspect deeply nested objects quickly. Paste raw JSON in the input panel and click Format to generate a consistent, indented output that is easy to read and debug.

FAQ

Does this tool send my JSON to a server?
No. Parsing and formatting are done in your browser only using JavaScript. Your data never leaves your device.
What is the difference between format and minify?
Format adds indentation (4 spaces) and line breaks for readability. Minify removes all unnecessary whitespace for compact output, reducing payload size.
